The engines report a real MLX/ONNX peak through the subprocess/in-process boundary (asserted > 0 by the real integration tests), and the within-envelope math is unit-tested.

exit_gates.requirement: 工程自动化测试全绿；未经授权不发生任何下载。
exit_gates.note: The full suite is green (see `full_suite`: 1624 passed at the closure commit, including the fifteen real-model slow integration tests). No unauthorized download can occur: the inference imports run under HOME-isolated, network-blocked subprocesses writing zero files, and the models tree holds only the planned, pre-acquired asset files. The only authorized acquisition was the one-off ticket-04 download, recorded in constraint_events.

torch survives only as an artifact-free phantom node via the sanctioned override-dependencies pin (ticket 03); the cited tests assert no banned distribution is installable, torch appears only as the neutered phantom, the pyproject override is recorded, and torch is never importable.

exit_gates.requirement: every registry entry hash-verifies on disk
exit_gates.note: Each acquired asset's canonical file-manifest sha256 is re-derived from disk and matched to the recorded registry asset_sha256; identity is verified, not trusted.

exit_gates.requirement: production adapters fail typed (never download) when an asset is missing
exit_gates.note: Every real adapter re-hashes its pinned asset before load and raises a distinct typed error (vad/diarization/alignment/asr/ocr/text_semantics) on a missing or tampered asset, never attempting a network fetch.

exit_gates.requirement: the subprocess boundary returns memory (post-stage RSS assertion)
exit_gates.note: The Model runtime subprocess (ADR 0055) returns a positive peak_memory_bytes on child exit; a missing or negative peak is rejected as engine_response_invalid. The real ASR integration test confirms a genuine MLX peak is returned across the boundary.

exit_gates.requirement: envelope constant is 12 GiB everywhere it is asserted
exit_gates.note: capabilities.MAX_MODEL_RESOURCE_BYTES = 12 GiB is the single source of truth (ticket 02); text_analysis imports it rather than re-declaring, and an 18 GiB estimate pauses at the boundary.

models_downloaded (ticket 04) and media_processed (ticket 13) are both true, each recorded in project-state.json constraint_events with an object + purpose; paid_apis_used stays false. The cited tests assert the flips carry evidence and that the boundary constraint holds.

exit_gates.requirement: full-suite wall time stays within the ≤5-minute budget
exit_gates.note: The measured wall time and the <= 5-minute budget are recorded in `full_suite`; the cited test asserts the recorded value is within budget. The full suite includes the fifteen real-model slow integration tests; the heavy per-capability prototype runs are separate maintainer-invoked commands, not part of the pytest gate.

completed_work: Plan amendment (Phase 11 split from real-video testing into model acquisition & real engine integration; old Phase 11 renumbered to Phase 12), registry candidate completion, tool re-probe, and the 12 GiB resource-envelope shrink as the single source of truth.

Torch-free inference dependency group locked with the sanctioned torch-phantom override and a lockfile gate; seven maintainer-confirmed model downloads plus RapidOCR from the pinned wheel = eight acquired registry entries, each hash-verified from disk.

The Model runtime subprocess seam (ADR 0055) and the seven real engines wired beside the controlled offline adapters (ADR 0037): silero VAD and sherpa-onnx diarization in-process (ONNX-scale), Qwen3 forced alignment, both ASR adapters, and Qwen3-4B text_semantics out-of-process (MLX-scale), RapidOCR ocr_primary in-process from bundled wheel models; the new text_semantics capability and its model-specific calibration (ADR 0056).

Prototype material acquisition (two Public-Domain VOA clips), the reusable pytest-gated prototype harness, and the fourteen maintainer-invoked real prototype runs with retained device baselines and per-capability samples; the text_semantics prompt-v2 adapter fix and recalibration (ticket 15) that flipped its sample from model_output_invalid to confirmed Chinese-prose segments.

This closing exit-gate inventory with tests/acceptance/test_phase_11_inventory.py (regex-derived plan gates, the seven specified derived gates, AST-verified citations, machine-checked constraint flips and closure ritual, measured device peaks within the 12 GiB envelope, and the full-suite wall-time budget).
open_requirements: The five 本阶段不能验证 real-video quality questions (real zh/en ASR accuracy, real overlapping-speech quality, real subtitle forced-alignment success, real OCR recall and digit accuracy, real long-video summary faithfulness) remain out of reach without human reference and are the subject of Phase 12 real-video testing.

diarization cluster_threshold tuning, text_semantics multi-segment behaviour, and CLI wiring of the real engines are Phase 12 concerns (real engines currently slot beside the offline path per ADR 0037).
